Multimodal M1 — architecture fit-check and real-data preparation

Status

Warning

M1 is not promoted. M1.1 establishes synthetic multimodal architecture and optimization evidence only. M1 promotion still requires real-data evaluation: caption NLL improvement against the no-image baseline, retrieval improvement, text regression within the defined tolerance, no NaNs, and reproducible CPU behaviour. The synthetic result (10.747 -> 0.2821) must not be presented as M1 training evidence.

Milestones

  • M1.1 — COMPLETED. Synthetic multimodal architecture fit-check.

  • M1.2 — in preparation. Real-data infrastructure (no large training run).

  • M2 — NOT STARTED. No image generation, no VQ-VAE, no image-token vocab.

M1.1 — architecture completed

Components

  • training/vision.py — from-scratch ViT: PatchEmbed, GQA-capable VitAttention, pre-norm SwiGLU VitBlock, VisionEncoder. Patch 16, 112 x 112 input -> 49 patches + CLS = 50 image tokens. Learned positional embeddings (no RoPE), non-causal self-attention.

  • training/multimodal.py — QMMultimodal: VisionEncoder -> Projector (Linear(128,256) -> SiLU -> Linear(256,128)) -> shared QM decoder. MM attention mask semantics: image->image visible, text->image visible, text->text causal, image->text blocked. Vocab 49156 = 49152 BPE + 4 specials: IMG_START (49152), IMG_END (49153), CAPTION_START (49154), TEXT_EOS (49155). Future image-token vocab boundary 51200 is documented only.

  • training/model.py — additive M0 refactor: embed/decode/ forward_embeds plus an optional attn_mask in Attention; the M0 forward and its causal behaviour are unchanged.

  • training/image_data.py — ImageTextDataset synthetic loader (unchanged path in M1.2).

  • training/train_mm.py — fit-check training loop.

  • scripts/synth_images.py — deterministic hermetic synthetic pairs (6 colors x 5 shapes x 6 positions x 2 sizes).

Synthetic fit-check completed

Ran 500 steps on CPU (1 thread) warm-started from the real local_15m M0 checkpoint, on 256 synthetic pairs:

  • initial loss 10.747 ~= ln(49156) (uniform-loss baseline ~10.80)

  • final loss 0.2821 (target < 8.0) — synthetic memorization achieved

  • ViT and Projector gradients non-zero and finite throughout

  • conditioning probe: max logit diff ~0.578 — the image changes next-token distributions

  • CPU wall-clock ~1411 s for 500 steps at ~345 tok/s (1 thread)

  • 9,513,216 params total (text 7,768,192 + vision 1,679,488 + projector 65,536)

Tests

  • python -m pytest tests -q — 65 passed at M1.1, 85 after M1.2.

  • tests/test_vision.py, tests/test_multimodal.py (mask semantics, special-token layout, gradients reach ViT/projector), tests/test_m0_compat.py (vocab-extension preserves rows, bit-identical logits on the original 49152 columns).

M0 compatibility result

  • Warm-start loads the text backbone with 0 new/ignored params.

  • torch.equal holds across all 49152 text-logit columns vs the untouched M0 model; tok_emb rows 0..49151 identical; tied lm_head identical.

  • Existing checkpoint keys (model/optimizer/step/config/cfg) preserved; metadata added additively.

CPU fit-check result

See Synthetic fit-check completed. Result artifact: runs/mm_fit_check/checkpoint_last.pt (gitignored).

Limitations

  • Synthetic, hermetic data only — no real images, no caption quality.

  • No M1 training evidence; memorization of 256 triple-patterns is not a skill.

  • Single image span per sequence; multi-span is masked but not exercised.

  • No image generation or continuous-embedding decoding (M2).

  • M1.1 is architecture + optimization evidence only.

M1.2 — real-data preparation

Dataset structure

data/mm_m1/
    MANIFEST.json      # provenance-aware sample index (schema version 1)
    DATA_CARD.rst      # data card
    ACQUISITION.rst    # acquisition & provenance procedure (real-data gate)
    train/             # split directories; image files are never committed
    val/
    test/

Real images are not committed; data/mm_m1/.gitignore keeps them out. Nothing is downloaded automatically.

Acquisition & provenance procedure

data/mm_m1/ACQUISITION.rst defines the real-data admission contract: required image/caption fields, dataset identity, source URL or acquisition reference, license plus license evidence, acquisition date, image checksums, split policy, duplicate handling, file-naming rules, transformation recording, and the strict rejection of records with incomplete provenance. Synthetic hermetic pairs (scripts/synth_images.py / .npz path) can never be represented as licensed real training data: the strict validator rejects them, so MANIFEST.json stays an empty template until a human performs a documented acquisition.

Manifest validation

python -m training.validate_manifest --manifest data/mm_m1/MANIFEST.json --tokenizer tokenizer/qm_bpe_v0.json

reuses training/mm_manifest.load_manifest for schema/provenance parsing and adds file-level checks: image existence and readability, split/sample bookkeeping, duplicate ids/paths/content, per-image checksum consistency, caption encoding (with --tokenizer), and deterministic hashing (raw sha256 plus a canonical content digest). --require-complete-provenance rejects any sample missing license/acquisition-date/image-checksum — the gate licensed real training data must pass (exit code 1 = invalid).

Manifest format

Top-level: schema_version, preprocessing_version, dataset (name, splits, image resolution), samples. Each sample:

  • sample_id (required), split in {train, val, test} (required)

  • image_path (required, relative to the manifest directory)

  • caption (required)

  • source (required)

  • source_url, license, attribution, width, height (optional)

  • checksum (optional hex sha256), acquisition_date (optional ISO date), license_ref (optional license evidence) — required by the strict real-data admission gate

  • preprocessing_version

Parser: training/mm_manifest.py — load_manifest validates required fields and raises ValueError on malformed input.

Provenance requirements

source is required for every sample. license must be the actual license when known and null/absent when unknown. source_url and attribution are recorded when known. The project never invents provenance or licensing information; additions must be backed by a documented acquisition log.

Preprocessing

training/image_data.py::preprocess_image — deterministic, no augmentation:

  1. RGB conversion

  2. cover-resize (LANCZOS)

  3. center crop to the M1 resolution 112 x 112

  4. float32 (112, 112, 3) tensor in [0, 1]

  5. optional per-channel normalization when configured

RealImageDataset drives the flow MANIFEST.json -> image file -> RGB -> resize/crop -> M1 tensor -> caption/token sequence, exposes the same batch contract as ImageTextDataset, and fails loudly (FileNotFoundError with the sample id) on missing files. Pillow is required for image decoding.

Training configuration

configs/train/mm_m1_local.yaml — model, train/val/test manifests, image resolution, sequence length, batch, gradient accumulation, learning rate, warmup, scheduler, gradient clipping, seed, max steps, checkpoint directory, CPU thread limits. It replaces neither configs/train/mm_fit_check.yaml (synthetic) nor the M0 local_15m.yaml.

Reproducibility metadata

Checkpoints additionally record (additively, all existing keys preserved): configuration, random seed, dataset manifest identity/hash, training step, optimizer and model state, preprocessing version, and the git commit when available. No network access is required.
